about.title: About us
about.intro: Prime Bag Factory makes custom and ready-stock bags in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
about.p1: We work with retailers, grocery chains, promoters and industry to produce bags at wholesale volumes with dependable lead times.
about.p2: Every order can be customized with your colors, size and printed logo, priced with transparent quantity tiers.

legal.title: Legal & policies
legal.terms1: Custom bags from the Bag Builder are quote-based: the final price is confirmed after we review your request.
legal.terms2: For standard products, 50% of the order value is payable in advance at order confirmation; the remaining 50% is cash on delivery (COD).
legal.terms3: Production starts after the advance payment is received. Artwork approval is required before printing.
legal.terms4: Prices and delivery timelines quoted are valid until the date stated on the quotation.
